craft-and-cotton.title: 280 GSM Standard
craft-and-cotton.body: Every tee is cut from 280 GSM combed ring-spun Japanese cotton, knit tight for drape that holds its shape.

size-guide.title: Silhouette & Size Guide
size-guide.body: Our boxy block runs relaxed with a 2.5cm drop shoulder. Size down for a closer fit. Tolerance is ±1.2 cm.

garment-care.title: Discharge Print Longevity
garment-care.body: Wash cold inside out, line dry in shade. Discharge prints soften with age and never crack.

provenance.title: Cotton Provenance
provenance.body: 100% GOTS-certified organic cotton, traced from farm to atelier.

shipping-and-returns.title: Complimentary Worldwide Delivery
shipping-and-returns.body: Free shipping on orders over $120, flat $12 below that. Returns accepted within 30 days, unworn with tags. Every order can be followed live on the Archival Tracking page.
